programme.title: Les Miserables
programme.desc: Jean Valjean (Richard Jordan), convicted of stealing bread, is hounded for several decades by the relentless and cruel Policeman Javert (Anthony Perkins).

programme.title: The Last Train
programme.desc: Two people, a Frenchman Julien Maroyeur and a Jewish German woman (Anna Kupfer) met on a train while escaping the German army entering France.

programme.title: Carnival Of Souls
programme.desc: After recovering from a traumatic accident involving a drag race that results in the death of all except her, Mary accepts a job in a new town as a church organist, only to be dogged by a mysterious phantom figure that seems to reside in an old abandoned carnival. It is here that Mary must confront the personal demons of her spiritual insouciance.

programme.title: Bird of Paradise
programme.desc: A young man falls overboard and is saved by a beautiful Polynesian girl. They fall in love, but their idyll is smashed when the local volcano begins to erupt.
